subject: Tilt Commerce: Vendor registration, PO assertions, and self-bill question
messages:
From: Natalie Park <accounts-payable@tiltcommerce.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: finance@tiltcommerce.com
Date: 2028-06-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor enrollment + PO requirements for Redwood (Tilt Commerce)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick intro call today. We're ready to start vendor provisioning in our AP system so Redwood can receive POs and be paid on our standard cadence. To move this forward we need:

- Completed vendor enrollment form (attached)
- Confirmation of legal entity name and remit bank details to publish in our ERP
- PO assertion requirements (which PO fields must appear on invoices for automatic matching)
- Clarify whether Redwood prefers to be paid via ACH (US) or wire for enterprise invoices
- VAT handling: Tilt is EU-headquartered for specific accounts; we need to know whether Redwood will accept self-billed invoices or if you require the PO to be present on every invoice for our matching logic

Could you return the completed packet and a short checklist we can drop into our vendor record? We have a tentative payment term of Net45 for this deal but that can be aligned with your procurement team.

Attachments: Tilt_Vendor_Enrollment_Form.pdf

Thanks,
Natalie Park
Accounts Payable | Tilt Commerce
accounts-payable@tiltcommerce.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Note: I'd like a sample invoice PDF so our AP engineer can validate field extraction against our PO parser.

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Natalie Park <accounts-payable@tiltcommerce.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-30T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment + PO requirements for Redwood (Tilt Commerce)

Hi Natalie — great speaking earlier. Appreciate the clear list. I've attached our onboarding packet and a short checklist that maps to each item you requested. Key points up front: 

- Legal entity for contract & invoices: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789)
- Default remit: ACH (US) prefered; wire available if required (we include bank details in the onboarding packet)
- PO matching: our invoices need the customer PO number in the invoice header (field: "Customer PO / Order #") and the PO line reference per item (if multiple line items). If you include PO number only in the invoice body, our parser will not auto-match — please ensure field is in the top-level header.
- VAT / EU accounts: Redwood currently supports both customer-issued POs and self-bill arrangements. For Tilt's EU entities we recommend Tilt issue the PO and enable reverse-charge handling on your side. If Tilt prefers to self-bill (i.e., generate invoices on behalf of Redwood), we can accept that but need a signed self-bill agreement and confirmation that Tilt will populate VAT fields per EU rules.

Actionables attached:
- Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (includes bank remit and contact matrix)
- Sample_Invoice_Redwood_Example.pdf (pre-populated with PO header & line layout)

Next steps: 1) complete the Tilt_Vendor_Enrollment_Form and return the signed PDF, 2) confirm whether Tilt will self-bill or issue POs, 3) confirm remit method (ACH / wire) and provide the ERP vendor code you intend to give Redwood.

If helpful, Marissa (our finance ops lead) can join a short call with your AP engineer to validate parser fields against your PO/EDI format — Ben from Sales will monitor payment term alignment.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Packet.pdf; Sample_Invoice_Redwood_Example.pdf

From: Natalie Park <accounts-payable@tiltcommerce.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment + PO requirements for Redwood (Tilt Commerce)

Thanks Stephanie — packet received and clear. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) We will complete and return the enrollment form by EOD tomorrow. Signed copy will be attached.
2) Tilt prefers to continue issuing customer POs for matched invoices (we do NOT plan to self-bill at onboarding). That said, we may consider self-bill for consolidated monthly settlements later — we will notify you if we want to pursue.
3) Remit: ACH (US) is preferred. We will publish your bank details in our vendor card.
4) PO parsing: our ERP requires the PO number in the top-level invoice header to populate the PO reference on receipts.

One technical ask — our extractor expects the PO number to be in a single dedicated line (labelled "PO#" or "Purchase Order"). The sample invoice you attached looks close but your header label reads "Customer PO / Order #". Can you provide a tiny variant where that field label is exactly "PO#" so our parser recognizes it? If you can send that sample variant we will run a parser test immediately.

Attached: Signed_Enrollment_Form.pdf (we'll follow up with the merchant/vendor code once created).

Regards,
Natalie Park
Accounts Payable | Tilt Commerce
